sections.title: Description
text: An app to follow your tasks.

sections.title: The challenge
text: To-do apps are everywhere. Most of them get abandoned after two weeks. The challenge: make task management feel like something you'd actually want to open every morning not something you avoid.

sections.title: The strategy
text: The answer was to make it tactile. Cards you swipe, stack, and sort, not lists you scroll past. Grouping tasks into decks gives your work a shape. You see what's on your day at a glance, instead of drowning in one endless feed."

sections.title: The result
text: Carddi is a concept project — but the problem it solves is real. I wanted to explore what a task app looks like when it's designed around how people actually think, not around feature lists. Every screen went through at least three iterations before it felt right.
